C0277.title: Zhejiang "StarChain Data Case": AI Crawlers Illegally Harvested 530 Million Citizen Records for Resale
C0277.summary: In 2023, Zhejiang police uncovered the "StarChain Data Case," where a criminal syndicate used AI crawler technology to illegally harvest 530 million citizen information records and resold them through outbound call robots at 0.3 yuan per record.
